name: Selection gate prime (the base-run cache for the main tip, BH-9094)

knobs.note: BH-9094: how many suites bin/selection-gate-prime.sh primes per main sha, the ones red most often in the gate.txt records of the window, read as ${SELECTION_GATE_PRIME_SUITES:-20}. A value outside 1..200 is one ALERTS line and no prime.

BH-9094: the age of the gate.txt records bin/selection-gate-prime.sh counts reds in (find -mtime -N), read as ${SELECTION_GATE_PRIME_WINDOW_DAYS:-7}. A value outside 1..30 is one ALERTS line and no prime.

BH-9094: the bound of the one prime run on the test host, read as ${SELECTION_GATE_PRIME_TIMEOUT_S:-900} (the same as SELECTION_GATE_BASELINE_TIMEOUT_S). A run that reaches it caches nothing. A value outside 5..3600 is one ALERTS line and no prime.

BH-9094: REMOTE_GATE_P of the prime run, read as ${SELECTION_GATE_PRIME_P:-4}: a third of the gate's 12, so the hourly run takes little of the shared test host. A value outside 1..16 is one ALERTS line and no prime.

BH-9094: retention. bin/selection-gate-prime.sh deletes the state/selection-gate/baseline/<sha> dirs older than this (find -mtime +N) at the start of each run, read as ${SELECTION_GATE_PRIME_KEEP_DAYS:-2} (the gate's own SELECTION_GATE_BASELINE_KEEP_DAYS). A value outside 1..14 is one ALERTS line and no prime.

BH-9094: how many of the newest primed shas state/selection-gate/prime.tsv carries to the pool machines, read as ${SELECTION_GATE_PRIME_RELAY_SHAS:-3}. 3 x 20 rows is about 6 KB, one mput. A value outside 1..24 is one ALERTS line and no prime.

BH-9094: the bound of the `git fetch origin main` at the start of each run, read as ${SELECTION_GATE_PRIME_FETCH_TIMEOUT_S:-60}. A failed or slow fetch is one log line and no prime. A value outside 5..600 is one ALERTS line and no prime.

Read by bin/selection-gate-prime.sh as ${SELECTION_GATE_PRIME_REPO:-/root/repos/cromford}: the checkout it fetches and makes the worktree from. Its dir name is the project whose gate.txt records count. Test seam; NOT settable from the control plane.

Read by bin/selection-gate-prime.sh as ${SELECTION_GATE_PRIME_RUNNER:-<worktree>/bin/remote-gate.sh}: the runner. Unset (empty) means bin/remote-gate.sh of the primed worktree. Test seam; NOT settable from the control plane.
